description: Two guards, then an archer at 12s. The 45-second repeatable target.
notes: THE GATE. The transcript's first concrete target: a ~45-second fight against two swordsmen and one archer, repeatable twenty times. The minimal build is not "done" when it compiles — it is done when it can run *this*, twenty times, and produce evidence about whether the repetition improved anything (lab spec §9).
The archer arrives at 12s rather than at the start so the fight has two distinct phrases: a clean melee exchange, then the same exchange with a reason to move.
Generous against a 45-second target: the clock exists to end a stalemate, not to
become the challenge. A run that needs 75s is data, not a failure of the harness.
